title: GD-SB/GD-ST support dimension versus pipeline strain covariance
reason: KEL support-sizing work prevents default oversizing, but current evidence is insufficient to quantify how support dimensions and stiffness covary with global strain and moment response.
required_before_claim: Before claiming support dimensions are strain-optimal, add parametric evidence linking GD-SB/GD-ST dimensions and connector spacing to pipeline and component responses.
